subject: Manager-01 prepared ten-agent swarm matrix and evidence review contract
body: Manager-01 completed the first substantive manager work package. The six prepared R&D lanes are decomposed into ten bounded specialist assignments with explicit scope, required outputs, dependencies, privacy restrictions, and completion criteria. A separate manager evidence-review contract defines source preference, freshness handling, contradiction reconciliation, disposition states, privacy/security rejection criteria, and the packet format for recommendations to Primary. These materials prepare the project for the planned ten-research-agent swarm without launching specialists while the R&D gate remains closed.
